newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose at the weekly auction on Tuesday on active buying by mostly overseas buyers, brokers said.
They said buyers from Poland were most active while Pakistan and Jordan also lent a good support. Bold and large brokens enjoyed increased demand from foreign buyers.

Some 963,490 kgs of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 52.07 taka per kg, 1.78 taka up from previous sale. The next auction will be held on January 28 with an expected offer of 1.01 million kg. ($1 = 42.45 taka)
